proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ b c D hb hc hD _
  have hbn : ‖b‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hb
  have hcn : ‖c‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hc
  have h1 : inner ℝ b D = (1 / (‖b‖ + ‖c‖)) * (‖c‖ * ‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ * inner ℝ b c) := by
    rw [hD, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have h2 : inner ℝ c D = (1 / (‖b‖ + ‖c‖)) * (‖c‖ * inner ℝ b c + ‖b‖ * ‖c‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [hD, real_inner_smul_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_comm b c]
  unfold InnerProductGeometry.angle
  congr 1
  rw [h1, h2]
  generalize ‖D‖ = d
  generalize inner ℝ b c = q
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · simp [hd]
  · have hs : ‖b‖ + ‖c‖ ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    ring
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (b c D : V), b ≠ 0 → c ≠ 0 → D = (1 / (‖b‖ + ‖c‖)) • (‖c‖ • b + ‖b‖ • c) → D ≠ 0 → InnerProductGeometry.angle b D = InnerProductGeometry.angle c D
